name: Disco Dolly
bio: Queen of the glowing dancefloor in Glitterball Groove. Lives under the giant mirrorball.

portrait.subject: a cute 70s disco diva girl with a huge curly afro, gold glitter jumpsuit, star sunglasses and a tiny mirrorball earring
portrait.background: sparkling 70s disco floor with rainbow lights and a mirrorball

request: Hey groovy! Disco Dolly from Glitterball Groove! Boogie with me? 🪩
hello: Far out! You've got the moves, baby!
Match those mirrorballs! They're the groovy ones!
about: I'm Disco Dolly! I rule the floor under the giant mirrorball. Records, stars, hearts, daisies. Swap 'em and match 'em, baby!
how: A disco match-3: swap neighbouring tokens on the glowing dance floor to match three or more, and make big combos to the beat.
tips: Matches at the bottom shake everything up!
Make 5-in-a-rows for the big special tokens.
Look for L and T shapes!
chat: The mirrorball spun so fast today I saw 400 of me.
Did the hustle for six hours. Feet are fine. Shoes are not.
Lost a sequin. Found it in my afro.
It's always Saturday night here, baby.
nudge: The floor's lit up! Let's dance! 🪩
idle: {ago} off the dance floor? Baby, no!
The mirrorball's been spinning alone for {ago}.
progress: You're on level {level}! Groovy! Next stop: {level+1}! 🪩

a: Wrong decade, but I love it!

update: Dig it! Glitterball Groove is now v{version}! 🪩
